name: CommandBarButton
description: Represents a button control on a command bar.
example:
Set c = CommandBars("Custom").Controls(2)
With c
If .Type = msoControlButton Then
    If .Style = msoButtonIcon Then
        .Style = msoButtonIconAndCaption
    Else
        .Style = msoButtonIcon
    End If
End If
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CommandBarButton object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CommandBarButton object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: BeginGroup
properties.description: Gets True if the specified command bar control appears at the beginning of a group of controls on the command bar. Read/write.

properties.name: BuiltIn
properties.description: Is True if the specified command bar control is a control of the container application. Returns False if it's a custom control, or if it's a built-in control whose OnAction property has been set. Read-only.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Gets or sets the caption text for a command bar control. Read/write.

properties.name: DescriptionText
properties.description: Gets or sets the description for a command bar button control. Read/write.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: True if the specified CommandBar or CommandBarControl is enabled. Read/write.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Gets or sets the height of a command bar control. Read/write.

properties.name: HelpContextId
properties.description: Gets or sets the Help context Id number for the Help topic attached to the CommandBarButton control. Read/write.

properties.name: HelpFile
properties.description: Gets or sets the file name for the Help topic attached to the CommandBarButton control. Read/write.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Gets the ID for a built-in CommandBarButton control. Read-only.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Gets a Long representing the index number for a CommandBarButton object in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Sets or gets the horizontal position of the specified CommandBarButton control (in pixels) relative to the left edge of the screen. Returns the distance from the left side of the docking area. Read-only.

properties.name: OLEUsage
properties.description: Gets or sets the OLE client and OLE server roles in which a CommandBarButton control will be used when two Microsoft Office applications are merged. Read/write.

properties.name: OnAction
properties.description: Gets or sets the name of a Visual Basic procedure that will run when the user clicks or changes the value of a CommandBarButton control. Read/write.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CommandBarButton object. Read-only.

properties.name: Parameter
properties.description: Gets or sets a string that an application can use to execute a command from a CommandBarButton control. Read/write.

properties.name: Priority
properties.description: Gets or sets the priority of a CommandBarButton control. A control's priority determines whether the control can be dropped from a docked command bar if the command bar controls can't fit in a single row. Controls that can't fit in a single row drop off command bars from right to left. Read/write.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: Gets or sets information about the CommandBarButton control, such as data that can be used as an argument in procedures, or information that identifies the control. Read/write.

properties.name: TooltipText
properties.description: Gets or sets the text displayed in the ScreenTip of a CommandBarButton control. Read/write.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Gets the distance (in pixels) from the top edge of the specified CommandBarButton control to the top edge of the screen. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets the type of CommandBarButton control. Read-only.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Gets or sets the Visible property of the CommandBarButton control. True if the CommandBarButton is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Gets or sets the width (in pixels) of the specified CommandBarButton control. Read/write.

properties.name: IsPriorityDropped
properties.description: Gets True if the CommandBarButton control is currently dropped from the menu or toolbar based on usage statistics and layout space. (Note that this is not the same as the control's visibility, as set by the Visible property). Read-only.

properties.name: BuiltInFace
properties.description: Is True if the face of a command bar button control is its original built-in face. Read/write.

properties.name: FaceId
properties.description: Gets or sets the Id number for the face of a CommandBarButton control. Read/write.

properties.name: ShortcutText
properties.description: Gets or sets the shortcut key text displayed next to a CommandBarButton control when the button appears on a menu, submenu, or shortcut menu. Read/write.

properties.name: State
properties.description: Gets or sets the appearance of a CommandBarButton control. Read/write.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Gets or sets the way a CommandBarButton control is displayed. Read/write.

properties.name: HyperlinkType
properties.description: Sets or gets a msoCommandBarButtonHyperlinkType constant that represents the type of hyperlink associated with the specified command bar button. Read/write.

properties.name: Picture
properties.description: Gets or sets an IPictureDisp object representing the image of a CommandBarButton object. Read/write.

properties.name: Mask
properties.description: Gets or sets an IPictureDisp object representing the mask image of a CommandBarButton object. The mask image determines what parts of the button image are transparent. Read/write.

methods.name: Copy
methods.signature: Copy([Bar As Variant], [Before As Variant]) As CommandBarControl
methods.description: Copies a command bar button control to an existing command bar.

parameters.name: Bar
parameters.description: A CommandBar object that represents the destination command bar. If this argument is omitted, the control is copied to the command bar where the control already exists.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: A number that indicates the position for the new control on the command bar. The new control will be inserted before the control at this position. If this argument is omitted, the control is copied to the end of the command bar.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the CommandBarButton object from its collection.

parameters.name: Temporary
parameters.description: True to delete the control for the current session. The application will display the control again in the next session.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Runs the procedure or built-in command assigned to the specified CommandBarButton control.

methods.name: Move
methods.signature: Move([Bar As Variant], [Before As Variant]) As CommandBarControl
methods.description: Moves the specified CommandBarButton control to an existing command bar.

parameters.name: Bar
parameters.description: A Command object that represents the destination command bar for the control. If this argument is omitted, the control is moved to the end of the command bar where the control currently resides.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: A number that indicates the position for the control. The control is inserted before the control currently occupying this position. If this argument is omitted, the control is inserted on the same command bar.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets a built-in CommandBarButton control to its original function and face.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: Moves the keyboard focus to the specified CommandBarButton control. If the button is disabled or isn't visible, this method will fail.

methods.name: CopyFace
methods.description: Copies the face of a command bar button control to the Clipboard.

methods.name: PasteFace
methods.description: Pastes the contents of the Clipboard onto a CommandBarButton.

events.name: Click
events.signature: Click(Ctrl As CommandBarButton, CancelDefault As Boolean)
events.description: Occurs when the user clicks a CommandBarButton object.

parameters.name: CancelDefault
parameters.description: Is False if the default behavior associated with the CommandBarButton controls occurs, unless it's canceled by another process or add-in.
